about.title: About WeatherApp
about.description: A modern, beautiful, and responsive weather application built with React, Vite, and Tailwind CSS. It provides real-time weather forecasts, interactive maps, and persistent user preferences.
about.dataProvidedDesc: WeatherApp utilizes industry-leading meteorological APIs to provide accurate and real-time weather data. (Mock implementations are currently active for demonstration purposes).
about.techStackDesc: Carefully crafted with a custom design system, featuring a robust color palette, fluid typography, and glassmorphism UI elements. Built focusing on accessibility and responsive behavior across all device sizes.
